title: Configuration bundle or patch
description: Shape of the configuration seed format (document 21, sections 3 and 8). A bundle is a whole set: a preset, or a snapshot. A patch is an ordered list of upsert and retire operations by entity and key: a preset patch, an overlay, or a draft. The schema checks shape only. Meaning (orphans, coverage, safety floors) is the engine validator (OP-09, V01 to V44). References between configuration rows are stable keys, never IDs. Fields marked x-proposal are not adopted yet.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 1): the contract lists below are the fixed engine meanings. Labels, counts and order stay configurable. Entry points: the root validates a bundle or a patch and picks the profile from manifest.kind and manifest.presetKey. The $defs presetFile, entityFile, presetPatch and draftPatch serve the preset source folders. client-binding-patch.schema.json and fixture.schema.json reuse these $defs. Profiles per entity: seedRow (shipped presets, classes R and O), setRow (snapshots and exports, all classes, no wildcards), presetValues (preset patch upserts), draftValues (draft upserts, with working set fields). Field names follow document 21, section 3. Where document 21 drops the Json suffix of a document 20 column (value, triggers, conditions, emergencyRule, flagNotify, setupNotes), this schema follows document 21. References to operational rows end in Id (document 21, section 8.3).

versionNumber.description: The C02 Version Number. Absent on a draft preview.

draftPatchManifest.description: The manifest of a draft patch: an AI draft, a configuration file, a revert, an upgrade draft or a client binding patch.

baseVersionNumber.description: The active version the draft starts from (document 21, section 4.5).

summary.description: What the author wants, in plain words. The engine computes the real change summary.

presetEntities.description: One array per entity key, seed rows only.

role-group-binding.description: Always empty in a preset: role group bindings are client facts (V44).

snapshotEntities.description: One array per entity key. Set rows: all classes, no wildcards.

presetOperation.description: One operation of a preset patch or overlay. Seed fields only.

entity.description: The entity key. Child rows (list-value, tier-answer-option, decision-outcome) use a child key path.

values.description: Upsert only: the fields to set.

draftOperation.description: One operation of a draft patch. Seed and working set fields.

entity.description: The entity key. Child rows (list-value, tier-answer-option, decision-outcome) use a child key path.

values.description: Upsert only: the fields to set.

presetBundle.description: A preset bundle: a shipped preset, built or written whole. Seed rows only. Wildcards allowed; the build expands them.

snapshotBundle.description: A snapshot bundle: C02 Content Json, a draft preview, or an export. All field classes. No wildcards.

presetPatch.description: A preset written as a patch over its parent: an overlay, or a full preset with extends.

draftPatch.description: A draft patch: ordered upsert and retire operations by entity and key over a base version (C46 Change Json).

entityFile.description: One preset source file per entity: config/presets/<preset-key>/<entity-key>.json (document 21, section 8.1). Seed rows only.

entity.description: The entity key. It matches the file name.

code.description: A stable reason code, such as approval.ai-actor-not-counted.

entity.description: The entity the reason is about.

ref.description: The configuration key or row ID the reason points at.

ruleId.description: The validation rule (V01 to V44) or guard rule (G-01 to G-17) behind the reason.

validationReport.description: Validation Json: the OP-09 result (document 25, section 5.11).

acknowledgedWarnings.description: Reason codes of warnings the approver acknowledged.

configurationSet.description: C01 Configuration Set. An engine record: a preset or the working set. Never in a seed or a patch.

isInForce.description: True for the one working set the engine reads.

currentVersionNumber.description: The active version number. The one value the version probe reads.

configurationSetVersion.description: C02 Configuration Set Version. An append-only engine record, created only at activation. Never in a seed or a patch.

sourceDraftId.description: The C46 draft this version activated. Empty for version 1 under the bootstrap rule.

changeJson.description: The patch as applied, after any rebase.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical form of contentJson.

changeSummary.description: Computed by the engine from the diff. Never the AI's own text.

instructedById.description: The admin who instructed the change (D-10).

configurationDraft.description: C46 Configuration Draft. An engine record: a proposed change held as a patch until a person accepts it. Only the engine draft operations write it.

recordNumber.description: A number such as CFG-00012, assigned by the engine.
